=== ImageReplicator :: globally disabled ===
log=/var/log/fogcustom/fogreplicator.log dev=/dev/tty1 zzz=600
  [wlog groupmanager.log]  * Checking if I am the group manager.
   *  * Image replication is globally disabled
  [serviceRun end]

=== ImageReplicator :: storage group has gone ===
log=/var/log/fogcustom/fogreplicator.log dev=/dev/tty1 zzz=600
  [wlog groupmanager.log]  * Checking if I am the group manager.
  [wlog groupmanager.log]  * I am the group manager
   * Skipping, no such storage group: 3
  [serviceRun end]

=== ImageReplicator :: nothing enabled to replicate ===
log=/var/log/fogcustom/fogreplicator.log dev=/dev/tty1 zzz=600
  [wlog groupmanager.log]  * Checking if I am the group manager.
  [wlog groupmanager.log]  * I am the group manager
   * Starting Image Replication.
   * We are group ID: 3. We are group name: GroupOne
   * We are node ID: 7. We are node name: NodeSeven
   * Attempting to perform Group -> Group image replication.
  [getIds image field=- find={"isEnabled":[1],"toReplicate":[1]}]
   | There are no images available!.
  [serviceRun end]

=== ImageReplicator :: enabled but nothing associated ===
log=/var/log/fogcustom/fogreplicator.log dev=/dev/tty1 zzz=600
  [wlog groupmanager.log]  * Checking if I am the group manager.
  [wlog groupmanager.log]  * I am the group manager
   * Starting Image Replication.
   * We are group ID: 3. We are group name: GroupOne
   * We are node ID: 7. We are node name: NodeSeven
   * Attempting to perform Group -> Group image replication.
  [getIds image field=- find={"isEnabled":[1],"toReplicate":[1]}]
  [getCount imageassociation find={"storagegroupID":3,"imageID":[11,22]}]
   | There is nothing to replicate.
   | Please physically associate images to a storage group.
  [serviceRun end]

=== ImageReplicator :: two items, one primary to this group ===
log=/var/log/fogcustom/fogreplicator.log dev=/dev/tty1 zzz=600
  [wlog groupmanager.log]  * Checking if I am the group manager.
  [wlog groupmanager.log]  * I am the group manager
   * Starting Image Replication.
   * We are group ID: 3. We are group name: GroupOne
   * We are node ID: 7. We are node name: NodeSeven
   * Attempting to perform Group -> Group image replication.
  [getIds image field=- find={"isEnabled":[1],"toReplicate":[1]}]
  [getCount imageassociation find={"storagegroupID":3,"imageID":[11,22]}]
  [getIds imageassociation field=imageID find={"storagegroupID":3,"imageID":[11,22]}]
  [getList image]
   | Replicating postdownloadscripts
  [replicateItems group=3 node=7 item=FOG\Image#0 primary=no path=postdownloadscripts]
   | Replicating postinitscripts
  [replicateItems group=3 node=7 item=FOG\Image#0 primary=no path=dev/postinitscripts]
  [replicateItems group=3 node=7 item=FOG\Image#11 primary=yes path=-]
   | Not syncing Image: item22
   | This is not the primary group.
   * Attempting to perform Group -> Nodes image replication.
  [replicateItems group=3 node=7 item=FOG\Image#11 primary=no path=-]
  [replicateItems group=3 node=7 item=FOG\Image#22 primary=no path=-]
  [serviceRun end]
